description: Single and two storey side to rear extension; single storey rear extension; rear dormer; two roof lights in front roof slope; conversion of dwelling into two self contained flats (2 x 3 beds); separate amenity space; parking; bin and cycle stores (Demolition of garage/store)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">Reasonable
Exemption Statement, 252KR(01) REVA, 252KR(02) REV A, Flood Risk Assessment
(dated 26/12/2025), 252KR(23) REV A, 252KR(21) REV B, 252KR(22) REV B, Design
and Access Statement, Location Plan, Appendix G Proposed Sustainable Drainage
Systems, Appendix F Compensatory Flood Storage, Appendix E Surface Water Flood
Maps, Appendix D Environment Agency Flood Maps, Appendix C Geological Map,
Appendix B Existing and Proposed Plans, Appendix A Site location maps</span>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale,
colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number,
specification, and location of enhancements such as bat bad bird boxes, shall
be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and
retained in accordance with the approved details.<i><o:p></o:p></i></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><i>Prior to the commencement of works (other than
demolition) hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The statement shall
include details of the following: </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>a) identify suitably positioned unobstructed
outside space:</i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>&nbsp; &nbsp; i) for fire appliances to be positioned on </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>&nbsp; &nbsp;ii) appropriate for
use as an evacuation assembly point </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>b) is designed to incorporate appropriate
features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event
of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire
safety measures </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>c) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of
fire spread</i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i> d) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated
evacuation strategy for all building users </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>e) develop a robust management
strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published
(details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published
to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in f) provide
suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the
size and use of the development. </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>The development shall be operated in
accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></i></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p>Notwithstanding the approved details and prior to the
commencement of works of the development hereby permitted, full details of
permeable paving shall be submitted to, and approved in writing, by the local
planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with
these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted full details of bin stores and enclosures should be submitted to and approved writing by the Local Planning Authority. The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storages as approved and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development, evidence of Secured by Design Certification shall be submitted to the local planning authority to be agreed in writing, or justification shall be submitted where the accreditation requirements cannot be met. Secure by design measures shall be implemented and the development shall be retained in accordance with the approved details.&nbsp;</p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted full details of cycle storage and enclosures s</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">hould be submitted to and approved writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</span></p>

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal"><i>Notwithstanding the approved details, the development
hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been a scheme of hard and
soft landscape works for the site submitted to, and approved by the Local
Planning Authority. </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>Soft landscape works shall include: &nbsp; </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>i. planting
plans (at a scale not less than 1:100),&nbsp; </i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>ii. schedules of plants, noting
species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and&nbsp;
</i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>iii. proposed numbers / densities.&nbsp;</i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i> iv. Written specification of planting
and cultivation works to be undertaken, and</i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i> v. A landscape implementation
programme with proposed timing / dates for the works. &nbsp; <o:p></o:p></i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>&nbsp;</i></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>Hard landscape works shall include:&nbsp;</i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i> vi. details of
boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location) and gates&nbsp;
</i></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>vii.&nbsp;</i><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Defensible planting in front of the ground floor flat bedroom windows</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><i>viii. details of hard surfacing
materials to be used in the landscaping of the site.&nbsp; The development will
be undertaken in accordance with the approved details and thereafter retained.<o:p></o:p></i></p>
